methods.name: gradient descent iteration
methods.description: Each device updates its own local copy of all trainable model parameters using a global gradient signal broadcasted across all devices.

methods.name: Causal training for PINNs
methods.description: Algorithm presenting a general causal training method for Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). It includes reformulations of residual and initial conditions losses, an annealing scheme for parameter ϵ, and a stopping criterion based on the convergence of temporal weights wi.

methods.name: causal training strategy
methods.description: learning the solution sequentially within separate time-windows, enhancing time-marching approaches.

methods.name: synchronous data-parallelism
methods.description: Training across multiple GPUs where each GPU stores an identical copy of all trainable parameters. Batches of training data are split into sub-batches, one for each device.

methods.name: Taylor-mode automatic differentiation
methods.description: Employed to accelerate the computation of high-order derivatives using a truncated Taylor polynomial approximation.

methods.name: annealing strategy
methods.description: adjusting ϵ using an increasing sequence of values {ϵi}k i=1 to gradually increase the strength with which the PDE residual constraint is enforced
